types.name: shipping_option_id
types.description:
The ID of the shipping option that the shipping method
is created from.

types.name: custom_amount
types.description:
A custom amount to set for the shipping method.
If not provided, the shipping option's fixed or calculated amount will be used.

types.name: description
types.description: A note to describe the shipping method.

types.name: internal_note
types.description:
A note that is viewed by admins only to
describe the shipping method.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the shipping method.
